Interface ConstructionStrategy

All Known Implementing Classes:
ConstructionStrategy.BeanStrategy, ConstructionStrategy.BuilderStrategy, ConstructionStrategy.CanonicalConstructorStrategy, ConstructionStrategy.CanonicalFactoryMethodStrategy, ConstructionStrategy.ConstructorStrategy, ConstructionStrategy.FactoryMethodStrategy, ConstructionStrategy.RecordStrategy
public interface ConstructionStrategy
Strategy used to construct objects from a set of Attribute values.

The resolution is structural: a constructor or static of(...) factory is considered compatible when every provided attribute matches one of its parameters.

When multiple compatible constructors or factories are available, the selection is strict:

  • a candidate is selected automatically only when there is a single exact match, that is, a single compatible executable whose number of parameters is equal to the number of provided attributes;
  • if both a constructor and a factory remain viable, or if more than one exact match exists, the resolution is considered ambiguous and fails;
  • compatible executables with extra parameters do not win over an exact match.

Missing attributes are handled according to the construction model of the target type:

  • records, constructors and static factories receive null for unmatched parameters;
  • builders receive only the attributes that were explicitly provided;
  • beans are created or reused and only the provided attributes are applied.
This allows immutable types to enforce their own invariants in their constructor or factory, while still supporting partial builders and anemic mutable beans.
